contract: SPEC A23-26 HUD v2 via HudLayout.Compute(env) -> { [id] = {X,Y,W,H} } in MainGui logical units: items keep their approved distance to their edge (TL / TC / TR / BC; BR to the PC corner or the live touch jump button), top rows follow the real top-bar inset, narrow phone safe areas shrink the whole layout, touch targets >= 60du (the rail re-spaces so grown buttons never touch; both potion cells, the potions rect growing up and then left up to the thumbstick zone, Gap published as out.potions.Gap), pressable items >= 2du apart, the touch quest board >= 48du tall, env.PouchLine adds pouch_line under the XP bar and moves only the minimap, one centre column (meter, chip row with zone / luck / status chips, notify) between the left and right blocks with >= 240du for the meter, everything on screen below the top bar; the reference screens match the approved sheet within 1 px.
limitations: Pure-function check only: no Roblox engine, so text fit, art, real GuiInset / safe insets, the real TouchGui (assumed to share MainGui's safe area), chat window size and the PlayerList are estimates. Studio captures at 1280x720 / 749x361 / 844x390 are separate evidence.
